settings.heading: MULTI SPRAY INFINITY
settings.alt: The SIDIZ Multi Spray INFINITY bottle
settings.description: The SIDIZ Multi Spray INFINITY is a premium fabric deodorising and room spray, made to deepen the immersion of the spaces where you work and rest.

settings.heading: SIDIZ INFINITY Fabric Multi Spray
settings.body:
• Deodorising made for fabric and mesh - excellent deodorising tuned to chairs, curtains, bedding and other fabric and mesh surfaces.
  • A considered scent - citrus top notes flowing into a soft musk base, in a distinctive composition.
  • Sustainable packaging - a top-grade recyclable clear PET bottle, a fully removable label and certified eco-friendly paper packaging.

settings.tag: Why does a chair brand make a spray?
settings.heading: Multi-deodorising, from chairs to bedding
settings.description:
Spray lightly two or three times wherever you would like the scent - bedding, curtains, chairs. The deodorising action keeps fabric and mesh surfaces fresh.

*Do not spray directly on the body, or near eyes and skin. *If discolouration is a concern, test a small hidden area first. *Do not spray directly onto leather.
settings.alt: Spraying INFINITY onto a mesh chair

settings.heading: Complete your universe with scent
settings.description: A long-lasting citrus musk: INFINITY cheers on the boundless possibility that expands past every boundary. It opens on light citrus notes and leaves a soft, lingering musk. TOP: bergamot, grapefruit, orange, lemon, spearmint. MIDDLE: rose, jasmine, geranium, ivy. BASE: muscone, musk. *10 per cent fragrance concentration; lasts around 4-5 hours, varying with temperature and environment.

settings.title: A collaboration with Pale Blue Dot
settings.description: SIDIZ, proposing the journey toward being yourself, meets Pale Blue Dot, recording travel's moments in scent - a fragrance for adventurers who value experience.
settings.alt: The SIDIZ and Pale Blue Dot collaboration

settings.title: The scent of The Progressive stores
settings.description: The perfumer's craft and the comfort of chairs, distilled: the mood of SIDIZ's The Progressive stores in Korea, captured as a scent.

settings.heading: 100 per cent recyclable packaging
settings.description: Peel the label and the bottle recycles completely - top-grade clear PET, in a box of certified eco-friendly paper. So the everyday leads on to the sustainable, SIDIZ keeps the circle turning. *The pump is a composite material and goes in general waste.
settings.alt: The INFINITY bottle and its packaging

settings.title: A fully removable label
settings.description: Reuse the bottle any time, and recycle it without fuss.

settings.title: Top-grade recyclable PET
settings.description: No needless finishing to hinder recycling - clear, high-purity material for the best recovery.

settings.title: Certified eco-friendly paper
settings.description: FSC-certified, chlorine-free, acid-free paper from sustainably managed forests.

settings.question: How do I keep a mesh or fabric chair smelling fresh?
settings.answer: Spray INFINITY lightly two or three times on the backrest, seat or wherever you would like the scent - it deodorises and keeps mesh and fabric fresh for a long while, and works on bedding and curtains too.

settings.question: What does it smell like, and how long does it last?
settings.answer: A premium fragrance blended with Pale Blue Dot at 10 per cent concentration, lasting around 4-5 hours. It opens on light citrus - bergamot and orange - and settles into a calm, steady musk, well suited to home offices and other spaces built for focus.

settings.question: How do I recycle the empty bottle?
settings.answer: Peel off the fully removable label and recycle the bottle as clear PET. The spray pump is a composite material and goes in general waste. The box is FSC-certified eco-friendly paper. Do not spray directly onto leather.
